name: flame
description: Represents heat, activity streaks, or trending energy. On hover the flame flares with thermal expansion while two embers break off and rise.

provenance.notes: Base flame path picked from a third-party icon site by the maintainer and animated via Gemini; exact source site unconfirmed (56x56 grid). License status: pending human review — confirm the source site before promoting to stable. The icon uses a 56x56 coordinate space rather than the trix-icons standard 24x24 viewBox; documented intentional deviation to preserve the contributed geometry exactly.

animation.description: The flame body flares (scaleY up to 1.12, scaleX down to 0.92, skewX wind-flicker ±3deg, 0.65s easeInOut) pivoting at its base (28, 53.6) so it stays grounded to its fuel source. Two ember sparks break off mid-flare and rise (-18/-22px) fading in then out. One-shot, ends at rest. Scale is justified here: thermal expansion is the meaning. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: Provide context (e.g. streak count) when used as a status indicator.
